Game Overview

In Zombie Rage, the core idea is straightforward: survive a thrilling arcade challenge in Zombie Rage. Collect brains, dodge rockets, and outscore rivals in a fast-paced race for points. Navigate with simple touch controls and strategic agility, making it a perfect quick-play treat for everyone. Stay sharp and dominate the competition in this explosive frenzy!
